events.title: Fields of Aaru's Next Fest demo update is out!
events.summary: Hi everyone, The updated demo is now free to play on Steam. Here's what's changed since June. If you haven't played before, Fields of Aaru is our cozy life sim set in the ancient Egyptian afterlife, where you farm along the Nile and help restore a village. Note: Old demo saves won't work with this update. You'll need to start a new game! events.title: Demo Update #2: Improved Controller Support
events.summary: Hey everyone, We've got exciting news! We've just released the second update for the demo, which includes various fixes and much improved controller support. This update adds proper controller navigation across all the UI interfaces, along with controller prompts for all input actions, so it should be a much smoother experience overall. events.summary: Thank you so much to everyone who has played the Fields of Aaru demo, wishlisted, reviewed, reported issues, shared feedback, or supported us.
